title: Upload-link page: English-only in a zh-CN deployment, and it names neither the record nor the field the file goes to
body:
domain:ui#6 · os-sales · session_01L6bhgUAXJEaRNwDiLuAvEZ

carries item 3 of #32684; #32684 keeps item 1 (the file-type refusal read as a permission error, and the file widget's missing `accept` hint). Item 2 (the unique violation naming no field) is carried by a separate card.

Filing category: ① product defect (user-visible). reach: as measured on #32684 (the page `create_upload_link` hands out, `/api/v1/storage/upload-links/…`, in a browser, zh-CN deployment; cloud `ff373e02`, framework `d7c3d44e`).

## 维护者速读

管理员或智能体用 `create_upload_link` 给别人发上传链接时，对方打开的页面全是英文（「Upload a file / A file was asked for … / Send / Done」），即使部署是中文；页面也不说文件会放进哪条记录、哪个字段。注意：页面源码头注释写明「不显示记录、字段、用户或组织」是 #30892 当时有意的设计，所以「显示记录和字段」这一半需要先确认要不要改那个决定；「本地化」这一半没有这个顾虑。

## What happens (from #32684 item 3)

The page reads only English ("Upload a file / A file was asked for, to be put in a file field of a record … / File / Send / Done. The file was attached; you can close this page.") in a zh-CN deployment, and does not say which record or field the file goes to.

## Where it lives (read on `6bbdf301`)

- `packages/services/service-storage/src/upload-link-page.ts` (server-rendered HTML), with the link view in `record-file-access.ts` and `upload-link-wire.ts`.
- Its header comment (~:15-18) says the page "names no record, field, user or organization" by design (#30892). Naming them reverses that choice, which is a decision for a person, not a lane.
- Localizing needs a locale source on that unauthenticated route (Accept-Language, or the deployment/tenant default locale).

## Expected

(a) The page is localized (at least zh-CN beside en). (b) Whether it names the record and field is decided first; if yes, it names them.

Reader who acts: `domain:server` (service-storage). Triage decides lane, grade, and whether (b) goes to the decision box.

Dedupe: `repo:objectstack-ai/objectstack is:issue upload link page localized` → 21 hits, only #32684 and QA-run cards; none on this page's copy.
